subject: Supplier onboarding — privacy intake & procurement forms
messages:
From: Sofia Liang <sofia.liang@acmehealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2025-11-05T08:52:00-08:00
Subject: Supplier onboarding kickoff — intake form and privacy questions

Hi Laura,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor onboarding with us. Attached is Acme Health's standard supplier intake worksheet (Acme_Supplier_Intake_Form.xlsx) — please complete the sections on contact, billing, and data handling. Before we proceed with PO issuance we'd like to confirm a few items related to privacy/security so we can route approvals:

- Do you have a standard DPA you ask customers to sign, or do you expect us to sign your DPA? If you have a template, can you attach?
- Please provide your current list of subprocessors (or a link to the registry).
- For onboarding purposes, what is your default data retention policy for customer content and logs? Can retention be adjusted per contract?
- Are you willing to commit to EU data residency for accounts that require it? If so, which regions are available?
- Can you confirm whether customer-provided data is encrypted at rest and in transit, and whether you publish SOC/ISO attestations?

If you can get the intake form back and answer the bullets above by EOD Friday 11/07 that would help speed procurement. Our AP team will need a draft SOW/contract or DPA to start the PO process.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to jump on a 20-min call if easier.

Thanks,
Sofia Liang
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
sofia.liang@acmehealth.com

Attachment: Acme_Supplier_Intake_Form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Liang <sofia.liang@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-05T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding kickoff — intake form and privacy questions

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear list and the intake worksheet.

Quick answers up front, with attachments:
- We have a standard DPA; attaching Redwood_DPA_v2_2025.pdf for review. We're generally fine with counterparty signature but happy to discuss minor redlines (data residency, subprocessors scope).
- Attaching a current subprocessor registry (Redwood_subprocessor_list.csv). The list is updated quarterly; if you need a notarized snapshot for contract, we can provide that as part of procurement.
- Default retention: customer content is retained for 90 days by default for production accounts, and logs for 365 days. Retention is negotiable and can be set in contract for regulated customers — please indicate desired retention in the intake form.
- EU data residency: yes, we offer EU-hosted deployment (Frankfurt and Dublin) for Private/Dedicated customers and hosted accounts can be pinned to EU regions upon request (may require additional onboarding steps).
- Encryption: all customer content is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). We publish SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations — we can provide the latest reports under NDA/limited distribution.

Next steps I'd suggest:
1) We fill the intake form and return a combined PDF by EOD 11/07.
2) Dev (copied) will follow up with a short data-map template so we can confirm any special categories of PHI/PII.
3) Marissa (legal) will review any DPA redlines and the PO terms.

Attached: Redwood_DPA_v2_2025.pdf; Redwood_subprocessor_list.csv; Redwood_data_map_template.docx

If you'd like, we can set a 20-minute slot Thursday morning to walk through the intake responses.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v2_2025.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_subprocessor_list.csv (text/csv), Redwood_data_map_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sofia Liang <sofia.liang@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-06T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding kickoff — intake form and privacy questions

Hi Sofia / Laura — looping in a couple clarification items from the infra/security side to make sure the intake gets routed correctly:

- Can you confirm the types of data Acme expects to send to Redwood (examples: customer prompt text, user identifiers, payment tokens, PHI)? If PHI is in scope we need to surface that early for contractual safeguards.
- Do you expect Redwood to process data on behalf of Acme in EU-only zones? If so, is the entire dataset EU-resident or a split-by-customer approach?
- For billing/PO: please tell us the AP contact name and whether Acme requires a specific PO template or vendor number. If AP requires a W-9, include that in the return.

I'll prepare a short data map template (attached) you can fill that lists data categories, retention required, and processing purpose. That will let legal and security sign off faster.

Thanks —
Dev
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_data_map_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Sofia Liang <sofia.liang@acmehealth.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-07T11:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding kickoff — intake form and privacy questions

Hi Dev / Laura — thanks for the quick responses. Attached is the filled intake form (Acme_Filled_Intake_2025-11-07.xlsx). Answers inline/high level:

- Data types: primarily de-identified clinical notes and metadata; some user identifiers (hashed), no raw payment tokens. We anticipate a small subset of records marked PHI — will flag those in the data map.
- Retention: default ask is 5 years for clinical records, 1 year for logs; please confirm feasibility or propose alternatives and indicate cost delta if any.
- Subprocessors: initial list is acceptable (Stripe for payments, AWS for hosting). If Redwood has additional analytics vendors, please list them in the CSV you provided.
- DPA: we can sign Redwood_DPA_v2_2025.pdf — AP will need Redwood's vendor name, EIN, and remittance address for the PO. AP contact is Accounts Payable <ap@acmehealth.com>.
- EU residency: not required for this initial pilot — US hosting is fine. For future expansions we may revisit residency.

AP next steps: please send a draft invoice or SOW to ap@acmehealth.com so they can open a PO. I'll follow up with any redlines on the DPA after legal review.

Happy to hop on a quick call if it helps to review the filled intake form.

Best,
Sofia Liang
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
sofia.liang@acmehealth.com

Attachment: Acme_Filled_Intake_2025-11-07.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
